expectations.text: The check command exits 0 (a script or package script was added)
The result is an executable script (or package script) that runs the steps in order and stops when the bundle-size check fails, rather than only a prose checklist or skill text
expectations.evidence: scripts/release.mjs runs build, `node scripts/check-bundle-size.js --max-kb`, `git tag`, then changelog in that order, and calls `process.exit(1)` on any non-zero step. It is wired up as `"release":"node scripts/release.mjs"`, and the test "size check failure stops the release: no tag, no changelog"

expectations.text: The script keeps the defaults that worked (--max-kb 250, tag from package.json version)
expectations.evidence: The script sets `const maxKb = maxIdx >= 0 ? args[maxIdx + 1] : "250"` and builds the tag with `const { version } = JSON.parse(readFileSync("package.json", "utf8")); const tag = `v${version}``. The happy-path test asserts `--max-kb 250` and tag `v1.2.3`.
